title: Compact-support coefficient maps in normalized scalar coordinates
statement: Let $A,B$ be finite commutative rings in universe $u$, $\varphi:A\to B$ a homomorphism, $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$ an open immersion of schemes in universe $u$, and $r:Z\to Y$ any scheme morphism. Fix normalized presentation data $m:\operatorname{Models}$ and use its normalized scalar adjunctions $S_T\dashv U_T$ and open presentations $J^A_j=\operatorname{openExtension}_A(j)$ of [def-sp-open-scalar-tensor-data], and $G_A=\operatorname{directImageConstantPush}_A(r)$ from [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Let $e_A:j^{\mathrm{intrinsic}}_{!,A}\cong J^A_j$ be reductionOpenModel [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison] and $\rho_{j,r}$ the canonical intrinsic restriction comparison [def-sf-intrinsic-compact-support-restriction]. For $N\in D(X,B)$ define the restriction arrow $R_N:G_AJ^A_jU_XN\to U_YG_BJ^B_jN$ by $U_YG_B(e_B(N))\circ\rho_{j,r}(N)\circ G_A(e_A(U_XN)^{-1})$. For $K\in D(X,A)$ define the coefficient comparison $c_{j,r,K}:S_YG_AJ^A_jK\to G_BJ^B_jS_XK$ as the inverse of the $S_Y\dashv U_Y$ Hom bijection applied to $R_{S_XK}\circ G_AJ^A_j(\eta_X(K))$. This is exactly the universal-arrow construction of [def-coef-compact-support-tensor-comparison] evaluated in these scalarPair/directImageConstantPush/openExtension coordinates. The recorded intrinsicCompactSupportCoefficientComparison uses different chosen scalar and compact-support presentations, so cannot be substituted definitionally; only those coordinates change here. No flatness, boundedness, invertibility or factorization identity is asserted.

No new arbitrary comparison is chosen.
